# buildkite_component_instance (Resource)

Registers a catalog Component on a Target. The Target and Component bindings are immutable. No deployment or observed version state is managed.

Destroy archives the registration, preserving history and reserving its name. Create rejects existing active or archived names by default. For manual recovery, unarchive through the API, then import the UUID. Alternatively, explicitly set `allow_unarchive_on_create = true` to restore a matching archived registration. Refresh treats an archived registration as absent; it never unarchives during read. Immutable binding changes require replacement, which can conflict with the reserved name; choose a different name or explicitly manage recovery. The provider never renames an old registration to force replacement.

Requires Releases enabled, `read_deployment_artifacts` and `write_deployment_artifacts` token scopes, and permission to manage organization rules for non-OIDC callers. In-place renaming requires the Releases by-ID PATCH API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "buildkite_deployment_artifact" "api" {
  name = "payments-api"
}

resource "buildkite_component" "api" {
  name          = "payments-api"
  artifact_uuid = buildkite_deployment_artifact.api.uuid
}

resource "buildkite_target" "production" {
  name = "production-au"
}

resource "buildkite_component_instance" "api" {
  target_uuid    = buildkite_target.production.uuid
  component_uuid = buildkite_component.api.uuid
  # Omit name to use the Component's name on create.
}

# Multiple differently named Instances can register the same Component on a Target.
resource "buildkite_component_instance" "worker" {
  name           = "payments-worker"
  target_uuid    = buildkite_target.production.uuid
  component_uuid = buildkite_component.api.uuid
}

# Changing a name renames in place. Changing a binding requires replacement.
# No versions are published and no deployment state is managed here.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `component_uuid` (String) The UUID of the catalog Component. Changing this binding requires replacement.
- `target_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Target. Changing this binding requires replacement.

### Optional

- `allow_unarchive_on_create` (Boolean) Allow create to restore an archived registration with the same name and matching immutable bindings, retaining its UUID and history. Defaults to `false`. Never adopts an active registration. This flag has no effect on updates or refresh.
- `name` (String) The Instance name, unique within its Target including archived Instances. Defaults to the Component's current name on create. Renamed in place; omitting it later retains the assigned name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The GraphQL ID of the registration.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the registration, used by the REST API and for import.

## Import

Using `terraform import`, import resources using the `id`. For example:
```shell
# Unarchive through the API first if archived, then import the REST UUID (not the GraphQL ID).
# The Target must be active before an Instance can be unarchived.
terraform import buildkite_component_instance.api 01a1b2c3-4d5e-7f60-8a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import instances using the `id`. For example:
```terraform
import {
  to = buildkite_component_instance.api
  id = "01a1b2c3-4d5e-7f60-8a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b"
}
```
